defects_introduced_and_measured_out.what: the regime panel overflowed 178px at 720px and 111px at 1440px
defects_introduced_and_measured_out.cause: the new anchor is a grid child, and a grid child without min-width:0 refuses to shrink below its content - this one holds a 22px figure plus two clauses
defects_introduced_and_measured_out.fix: min-width: 0 and grid-column: 1 / -1, because the anchor is the panel's heading rather than one fact among several

defects_introduced_and_measured_out.what: two tooltips pushed their panels sideways - 11px on the regime grid, 85px on the chip row
defects_introduced_and_measured_out.cause: the rightmost cell of a fact grid and the last chip in the summary row open their bubble past the panel edge
defects_introduced_and_measured_out.fix: the page already solves this for the header zones (.header-zone:last-child .has-tip::after { left:auto; right:0 }); the same flip was applied rather than a second remedy invented
defects_introduced_and_measured_out.instructive_detail: the 85px one appeared ONLY AFTER the shorter copy let the chips reflow onto fewer lines - this class of overflow moves when the text does, which is why it is measured at three widths after every copy change

defects_introduced_and_measured_out.what: the DOM fixture was pinning the OLD phrase
defects_introduced_and_measured_out.consequence: the layout probe reported the old wording as still visible after the backend had stopped emitting it
defects_introduced_and_measured_out.fix: the fixture now reads the backend constant and cannot drift from the copy the page receives
